metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · The Mosquito Bowl
metas.description: After Pearl Harbor, four star college footballers join the Marines. Before facing Okinawa's invasion, they participate in a historic game with legendary players - for many, their final match.

metas.name: 2026 · Being Heumann
metas.description: In 1977, disability rights activist Judy Heumann leads a historic 28-day occupation of San Francisco's Federal Building, uniting protesters in a fight for accessibility laws and equal rights.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · The Remarried Empress
metas.description: Empress Navier is shocked when her husband seeks divorce to wed his mistress. Refusing defeat, she allies with enigmatic Prince Heinrey, risking all to reclaim her throne and outshine her ex amid palace intrigue and romance.
